## Overview

This is a legacy script from the earlier all-site analysis (primary tumours plus metastatic biopsies from bone, lymph node and soft tissue). It is included for transparency and is not part of the bone-only pipeline. It corrects phase6. SpatialDecon's merged proportions (`prop_of_all`, `prop_of_nontumor`) silently dropped the ten automatically estimated tumour clusters, because safeTME's cell-type merge table has no mapping for them. This script recomputes the proportions from the unmerged `beta.granular` matrix. The full 18 safeTME subtypes are kept, giving tumour fraction as tumour / (tumour + immune/stromal) and CD45⁺ immune composition renormalised without tumour clusters. The mask validation and the response and timepoint comparisons of phase6 are then repeated.

No output of this script is used in the current analysis.

**Manuscript items supported**

- Not used by the manuscript (legacy; superseded by comp_03b/comp_17/comp_19)

**Pipeline step:** `./run_pipeline.sh --legacy` (optional; not needed to reproduce the manuscript, whose frozen inputs are in `data/previous_analysis/`). Approximate runtime: under a minute.

**Inputs**

- `results_legacy/phase6_spatialdecon_results.rds`
- `data/interim/phase2_se_with_qc_metrics.qs`

**Outputs**

- `results_legacy/Results/Phase6_SpatialDecon/mask_validation_FIXED.pdf`
- `results_legacy/Results/Phase6_SpatialDecon/CD45_celltype_proportions_FIXED.csv`
- `results_legacy/Results/Phase6_SpatialDecon/CD45_celltype_vs_response_FIXED.csv`
- `results_legacy/Results/Phase6_SpatialDecon/CD45_celltype_vs_timepoint_FIXED.csv`
- `results_legacy/Results/Phase6_SpatialDecon/CD45_composition_stacked_FIXED.pdf`

**Depends on**: `phase6_spatialdecon`

## Analysis

### Legacy correction of SpatialDecon proportions

The header explains why the merged proportions were wrong and why the finer 18-subtype resolution is kept.

Loads the phase6 result and splits the rows of `beta.granular` into tumour clusters and immune/stromal types. It then checks that the AOI selection matches the columns of `beta.granular`.

```{r phase6b-spatialdecon-fix-01}
## ============================================================================
## Phase 6b: recompute proportions from the clean beta.granular matrix
## (spatialdecon's own cellmerges-based prop_of_all/prop_of_nontumor silently
## dropped the 10 auto-estimated tumor.1..tumor.10 clusters since safeTME.matches
## has no mapping for them -- beta.granular itself has zero NAs and is used here
## directly instead, keeping the full 18 safeTME immune/stromal subtypes rather
## than the coarser 14-category collapse, since finer subtype resolution
## -- naive vs memory T cells, classical vs non-classical monocytes -- is more
## informative for the CD45+ question asked).
## ============================================================================
suppressMessages({
  library(qs); library(SummarizedExperiment); library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(ggplot2)
})
PRINCE_ROOT <- normalizePath(Sys.getenv("PRINCE_ROOT", "."))
RAW_DIR <- file.path(PRINCE_ROOT, "data", "interim")     # all-site QC'd objects written by comp_00a_qc
dir.create(file.path(PRINCE_ROOT, "results_legacy"), showWarnings = FALSE)
setwd(file.path(PRINCE_ROOT, "results_legacy"))           # legacy outputs; frozen copies used downstream are in data/previous_analysis

res <- readRDS("phase6_spatialdecon_results.rds")
bg <- res$beta.granular
tumor_rows <- grep("^tumor\\.", rownames(bg))
immune_rows <- setdiff(seq_len(nrow(bg)), tumor_rows)

se <- qs::qread(file.path(RAW_DIR, "phase2_se_with_qc_metrics.qs"))
cd_full <- as.data.frame(colData(se))
idx <- cd_full$qc_status == "PASS" & cd_full$response_group_neat != "Control" & !is.na(cd_full$neg_probe_geomean)
cd <- droplevels(cd_full[idx, ])
stopifnot(identical(rownames(cd), colnames(bg)))

```

### Mask validation

Computes the tumour fraction per AOI from the summed tumour-cluster and immune/stromal abundances. The fraction is summarised by compartment, and degenerate fits are counted.

```{r phase6b-spatialdecon-fix-02}
## ---- mask validation: total tumour vs total immune+stromal fraction, per AOI
total_tumor <- colSums(bg[tumor_rows, , drop = FALSE])
total_immune <- colSums(bg[immune_rows, , drop = FALSE])
cd$tumor_fraction <- total_tumor / (total_tumor + total_immune)
cd$nontumor_fraction <- 1 - cd$tumor_fraction

cat("================ MASK VALIDATION: tumour vs non-tumour fraction by segment ================\n")
print(cd %>% group_by(segment_name) %>%
        summarise(n = n(), median_tumor_frac = median(tumor_fraction, na.rm=TRUE), mean_tumor_frac = mean(tumor_fraction, na.rm=TRUE),
                  median_nontumor_frac = median(nontumor_fraction, na.rm=TRUE), n_degenerate_fit = sum(is.nan(tumor_fraction))))

p_mask <- ggplot(cd, aes(segment_name, tumor_fraction, fill = segment_name)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.6) + theme_bw() +
  labs(title = "SpatialDecon mask validation", subtitle = "Estimated tumour fraction by GeoMx segment (safeTME + auto tumour clusters)",
       x = NULL, y = "Estimated tumour fraction") + theme(legend.position = "none")
ggsave("Results/Phase6_SpatialDecon/mask_validation_FIXED.pdf", p_mask, width = 6, height = 5)

```

### CD45⁺ composition

Renormalises the immune/stromal abundances in CD45⁺ AOIs to proportions. The script reports the tumour fraction in CD45⁺ AOIs, which indicates mis-segmentation, and repeats the AOI-level tests against response group and timepoint. It also prints macrophage, monocyte-subtype and naive/memory T-cell summaries.

```{r phase6b-spatialdecon-fix-03}
## ---- CD45+ immune composition (proportion of the 18 safeTME subtypes, renormalized to exclude tumour clusters)
cd45_idx <- which(cd$segment_name == "CD45+")
immune_mat <- bg[immune_rows, cd45_idx, drop = FALSE]
prop_nontumor <- sweep(immune_mat, 2, colSums(immune_mat), "/")
celltype_df <- as.data.frame(t(prop_nontumor))
celltype_df$subject_id <- cd$subject_id[cd45_idx]
celltype_df$timepoint <- cd$timepoint[cd45_idx]
celltype_df$response_group_neat <- cd$response_group_neat[cd45_idx]
celltype_df$tumor_fraction <- cd$tumor_fraction[cd45_idx]

cat("\nCD45+ mean estimated tumour (mis-segmentation) fraction:", round(mean(cd$tumor_fraction[cd45_idx]), 4), "\n")

write.csv(celltype_df, "Results/Phase6_SpatialDecon/CD45_celltype_proportions_FIXED.csv", row.names = FALSE)

cat("\n================ CD45+ CELL TYPE COMPOSITION: mean proportion overall (18 subtypes) ================\n")
ct_cols <- setdiff(colnames(celltype_df), c("subject_id", "timepoint", "response_group_neat", "tumor_fraction"))
print(round(sort(colMeans(celltype_df[, ct_cols]), decreasing = TRUE), 4))

cat("\n================ CD45+ CELL TYPE vs RESPONSE GROUP (Archival+Screening) ================\n")
sub <- celltype_df %>% filter(timepoint %in% c("Archival", "Screening"))
test_rows <- list()
for (ct in ct_cols) {
  fit <- lm(sub[[ct]] ~ sub$response_group_neat)
  pval <- tryCatch(anova(fit)$`Pr(>F)`[1], error = function(e) NA)
  r2 <- summary(fit)$r.squared
  means <- tapply(sub[[ct]], sub$response_group_neat, mean)
  test_rows[[ct]] <- data.frame(celltype = ct, R2 = round(r2,4), pval = pval,
                                 mean_Intermediate = round(means["Intermediate"],4),
                                 mean_NonResponder = round(means["Non_Responder"],4),
                                 mean_Responder = round(means["Responder"],4))
}
test_tab <- bind_rows(test_rows) %>% arrange(pval)
print(test_tab, row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(test_tab, "Results/Phase6_SpatialDecon/CD45_celltype_vs_response_FIXED.csv", row.names = FALSE)

cat("\n================ CD45+ CELL TYPE vs TIMEPOINT (all patients) ================\n")
test_rows_tp <- list()
for (ct in ct_cols) {
  fit <- lm(celltype_df[[ct]] ~ celltype_df$timepoint)
  pval <- tryCatch(anova(fit)$`Pr(>F)`[1], error = function(e) NA)
  means <- tapply(celltype_df[[ct]], celltype_df$timepoint, mean)
  test_rows_tp[[ct]] <- data.frame(celltype = ct, pval = pval,
                                    Archival = round(means["Archival"],4), Screening = round(means["Screening"],4),
                                    Cycle1 = round(means["Cycle1"],4), DiseaseProgression = round(means["DiseaseProgression"],4))
}
test_tab_tp <- bind_rows(test_rows_tp) %>% arrange(pval)
print(test_tab_tp, row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(test_tab_tp, "Results/Phase6_SpatialDecon/CD45_celltype_vs_timepoint_FIXED.csv", row.names = FALSE)

cat("\n================ MACROPHAGE FRACTION: response x timepoint ================\n")
print(celltype_df %>% group_by(timepoint, response_group_neat) %>%
        summarise(n = n(), mean_macrophage = round(mean(macrophages),4), .groups = "drop"))

cat("\n================ MONOCYTE SUBTYPES (classical vs non-classical): response x timepoint ================\n")
print(celltype_df %>% group_by(timepoint, response_group_neat) %>%
        summarise(n = n(), mean_mono_classical = round(mean(monocytes.C),4),
                  mean_mono_nonclassical = round(mean(monocytes.NC.I),4), .groups = "drop"))

cat("\n================ T-CELL NAIVE vs MEMORY: response x timepoint ================\n")
print(celltype_df %>% group_by(timepoint, response_group_neat) %>%
        summarise(n = n(), mean_CD8_naive = round(mean(T.CD8.naive),4), mean_CD8_memory = round(mean(T.CD8.memory),4),
                  mean_CD4_naive = round(mean(T.CD4.naive),4), mean_CD4_memory = round(mean(T.CD4.memory),4), .groups = "drop"))

```

Saves the stacked composition plot.

```{r phase6b-spatialdecon-fix-04}
## stacked composition plot
long <- celltype_df %>% select(-tumor_fraction) %>%
  pivot_longer(-c(subject_id, timepoint, response_group_neat), names_to = "celltype", values_to = "prop")
top_types <- names(sort(colMeans(celltype_df[, ct_cols]), decreasing = TRUE))[1:8]
long$celltype_grp <- ifelse(long$celltype %in% top_types, long$celltype, "other")
p_stack <- ggplot(long %>% filter(timepoint %in% c("Archival","Screening","Cycle1")),
                   aes(x = response_group_neat, y = prop, fill = celltype_grp)) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "bar", position = "stack") +
  facet_wrap(~timepoint) + theme_bw() +
  labs(title = "CD45+ estimated immune composition (mean proportion, safeTME)", x = NULL, y = "Mean proportion", fill = "Cell type") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))
ggsave("Results/Phase6_SpatialDecon/CD45_composition_stacked_FIXED.pdf", p_stack, width = 10, height = 6)

cat("\nPhase 6b (fixed) complete.\n")
```
